faultFn: XMAHALAllocateContexts (RB3DX/TU5 VA 0x82bcef08, base_va 0x82b9bd40, size 272, HIGH confidence, body_identical) — Xbox360 XMA/XAudio2 hardware-abstraction layer allocating audio decoder contexts
eaExplanation: 0x7FEA1A80 is Xenia's XMA-decoder MMIO register aperture (xma_decoder.cc:113 AddVirtualMappedRange(0x7FEA0000,mask 0xFFFF0000,size 0xFFFF)). Offset 0x1A80 -> register 0x6A0 = Context0Clear (xma_register_table.inc:68), in-bounds of kRegisterCount=0x4000, fully handled (context.Clear() per set bit). The address is a deliberate compile-time constant (addis 0x1ffb/addi -0x7960/slwi 2), NOT a corrupted pointer. Guest stwbrx -> x86 movbe store -> PROT_NONE -> SIGSEGV -> MMIOHandler decodes movbe (mmio_handler.cc:144) -> XmaDecoder::WriteRegister -> RIP advances. This is normal, recoverable-by-design XMA MMIO emulation.
